text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria can be proud for having passed a turning point towards plural democracy after national conference which defined democratic rules for political competition.
- The government and the Transitional National Council met on Monday to prepare the council's session early next month to vote laws, including election legislation.
- The government to set up a privatisation council. The council's president and staff will be named in the next few days to speed up the sale of state-owned firms.
- Next year's general elections will reshape Algeria's political map and unveil the real intentions and weights of the political forces after the national conference.
- A government of national union might be still on the agenda. The idea was launched by President Liamine Zeroual in 1994 and it still possible.
